name: Fetchling Lore

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
You've learned obscure lessons about your fellow fetchlings. You're trained in Occultism and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the Additional Lore feat for Netherworld Lore.
